video.negative: bad video, distorted face, extra fingers, text, watermark, subtitles, muffled speech, distorted audio, loud background music

directives.native: Audio: only text inside <d> tags is spoken dialogue and must be voiced exactly; all other text is visual description and must never be voiced. Clear, intelligible Mandarin dialogue with accurate lip sync, natural ambience, no voice-over narration unless the prompt explicitly describes an off-screen narrator, no background music, no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
directives.ambient: Audio: ambient sound only, no intelligible speech, no dialogue, no voice-over, no background music; characters may move their mouths and gesture as if speaking, but their speech must stay unintelligible. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
directives.silent: Audio: silent video, no audio track at all; no speech, no dialogue, no voice-over, no ambience, no sound effects, no background music; characters do not speak and keep their mouths closed. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.

global_prompts.native: Natural synchronized audio: only text inside <d> tags is spoken dialogue and must be voiced exactly; all other text is visual description and must never be voiced. global_prompts.ambient: Audio: ambient sound only, no intelligible speech, no dialogue, no voice-over, no background music; characters may move their mouths and gesture as if speaking, but their speech must stay unintelligible. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
global_prompts.silent: Audio: silent video, no audio track at all; no speech, no dialogue, no voice-over, no ambience, no sound effects, no background music; characters do not speak and keep their mouths closed. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
